page_title: BOU 0-0 CHE | Bournemouth v Chelsea 17/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' The linesman points to the corner flag, Chelsea are going to take it.
90+5' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+5' The free kick from long range, taken by Bournemouth, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
90+5' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) commits a rough foul. David Coote stops the game and makes a call.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
90' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ryan Christie leaves the pitch and David Brooks (Bournemouth) comes on.
86' Ian Maatsen (Chelsea) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
86' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) hammers a powerful first-time shot from close range, sending the ball towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper stops it with a miraculous save.

84' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the bottom right corner of the goal. Neto displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
83' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) takes the corner which is cleared.
81' Here is a change. Enzo Fernandez is going off and Mauricio Pochettino gives the last tactical orders to Ian Maatsen (Chelsea).
80' The game has come to an end for Levi Colwill. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ben Chilwell (Chelsea).
80' The referee has issued a yellow card to Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea).
80' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bournemouth comes to nothing.
79' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Philip Billing (Bournemouth) on the edge of the box.
76' Axel Disasi (Chelsea) has tested the patience of referee David Coote and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
75' The photographers scatter as a shot from the edge of the box by Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) blazes well wide of the right post.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Milos Kerkez departs the field of play to be replaced by Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth).
73' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute Marcus Tavernier and he is replaced by Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth).
73' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
73' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bournemouth, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
72' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) brings his opponent down. David Coote has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
70' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
69' Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
68' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
66' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
65' Chelsea can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
65' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
63' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) replaces Dango Ouattara.
63' The referee signals a substitution. Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is brought on as a substitute for Mykhailo Mudryk.
63' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
62' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) is booked after bringing down an opponent. David Coote had an easy-decision to make.
60' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
58' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
56' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) sends a long ball forward to Dominic Solanke, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
54' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post.
51' A goal, which was scored by Levi Colwill (Chelsea), was disallowed due to offside.
51' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) unleashes a brilliant effort from the free kick, but the ball crashes against the bar. What a chance!
49' Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Chelsea.
49' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) makes a rough challenge and David Coote blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
47' Bournemouth control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
41' David Coote shows a yellow card to Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) for his blatant foul.
40' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
39' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) tries to find Nicolas Jackson, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
35' A toe poke from Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) heads right for the middle of the goal, but Neto is well placed and makes a good save.
32' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
31' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
31' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
26' A pass from Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is intercepted by Neto and the move breaks down.
23' Wow, what an escape. Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
23' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
21' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. David Coote stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
19' Great save! Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Robert Sanchez.
17' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
17' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) works the corner short.
17' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
16' The Chelsea players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
14' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) makes a strong challenge and David Coote blows for a foul.
14' POST! Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the left post. What a strike that was!
13' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
11' What a big chance! Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post.
10' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. David Coote blows his whistle for an infringement.
6' Rough tackle by Lewis Cook (Bournemouth). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
4' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) was quite harsh and David Coote didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
3' The referee points to the corner flag and Chelsea will take a corner.
3' The shot by Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Neto.
2' Chelsea enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Bournemouth will kick the game off.
David Coote is introduced as the referee for today's match.
